t: You're at Hammersmith War Memorial. It was made by Henry Charles Fehr, a British monumental and architectural sculptor working in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. Fehr made architectural sculpture for Middlesex Guildhall and for the city halls in Wakefield and Cardiff. In the 1920s he created many war memorials, often with detailed bronze figures, including those at Leeds, Colchester, Keighley and Burton upon Trent. This is one of that group.
